0.title: 规则
0.body:
德州扑克（Texas Hold'em）

每位玩家持有 2 张底牌，配合 5 张公共牌组成最佳 5 张牌型。

流程
1. 庄家顺时针轮换；庄家左手为小盲，再左手为大盲。
2. 发两张底牌后进行翻牌前下注。
3. 依次发翻牌（3 张）、转牌（1 张）、河牌（1 张）；每轮均可下注。
4. 剩余玩家摊牌，最佳五张牌赢得底池；同牌型平分。

两人局
庄家同时为小盲；另一位为大盲。

跑马（Run It Twice）
仅在所有仍在牌局中的玩家均已全下、且没有后续行动时使用，并应在发出剩余公共牌前由相关玩家一致同意。
- 底池平均拆为两份；同一组底牌分别跑两次剩余公共牌。
- 若翻牌后全下：先发第一跑的转牌、河牌，再回到翻牌面发第二跑的转牌、河牌。
- 若转牌后全下：从同一转牌面分别发两张河牌。
- 每一跑独立判定赢家并分配该半池；奇数筹码的归属应在开局前约定。
- 未一致同意时，默认只跑一次。

本模组当前提供发牌、筹码计数、投注区与庄家/盲注位置轮换；下注、边池、摊牌和跑马底池分配由玩家手动处理。

-- *************************************************************************

playZoneGUIDs = {"d81799", "d28ab5", "f2a644", "3775b1"}


-- *************************************************************************
-- [[ Player Zones]]
-- All zones scaled to {8.25, 10, 5}
-- Y Rotation can be computed as (index-1)*45
-- *************************************************************************

-- [[The following arrays contain Name, GUID and center position details for all colors in order: (White, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink). Grey and Black included at end for RGB matching.]]

-- *********************************************

--[[Array indicates the player status of each color. 0 = empty, 1 = playing, -1 = sitting out, -2 has not yet started. Grey and Black start as 0 as they will not spawn chips or sit out..]]

-- *************************************************************************
--[[ Game variables --]]
-- *************************************************************************
cardsArray = {}
cardPlacementMult = 2
foldIndex = 1
gameStateIndex = 0

-- Factor to adjust distance between chips
chipBaseRotation = {0,90,0}
chipSpacingX = 2

--[[ Position Variables - all other objects are positioned relative to the main deck]]
deckPosition = {-1.2,1.3,-2.5}
deckRotation = {0,180,180}


-- *************************************************************************
-- [[Functions]]
-- *************************************************************************


-- Create a visible, non-interactive border inside the overlapping central chip zones.
-- 3D text has no physical collision, so it does not interfere with cards or chips.
function createBettingAreaBorder()
    local function borderSegment(text, position, rotation)
        local segment = spawnObject({
            type = "3DText",
            position = position,
            rotation = rotation,
            scale = {x=1.25, y=1.25, z=1.25},
        })
        segment.TextTool.setFontColor({r=1, g=0.82, b=0.25})
        segment.TextTool.setFontSize(48)
        segment.TextTool.setValue(text)
        segment.setName("BettingAreaBorder")
        segment.setLock(true)
    end

    borderSegment("━━━━━━━━ 投注区 ━━━━━━━━", {0, 1.03, -7.5}, {90, 180, 0})
    borderSegment("━━━━━━━━ 投注区 ━━━━━━━━", {0, 1.03, 7.5}, {90, 0, 0})
    borderSegment("━━━━━━━━━━", {-8, 1.03, 0}, {90, 90, 0})
    borderSegment("━━━━━━━━━━", {8, 1.03, 0}, {90, 270, 0})
end

-- Visible poker-role markers. They are labels only: chip values are never changed.
dealerSeatIndex = 0

function getActiveSeatIndexes()
    local active = {}
    for index = 1, 8 do
        if colorStatusArray[index] == 1 then
            table.insert(active, index)
        end
    end
    return active
end

function nextActiveSeat(startIndex)
    for offset = 1, 8 do
        local candidate = ((startIndex - 1 + offset) % 8) + 1
        if colorStatusArray[candidate] == 1 then
            return candidate
        end
    end
    return 0
end

function spawnRoleMarker(colorIndex, label, fontColor)
    local center = colorCenterArray[colorIndex]
    local position = {center[1] * 0.86, 1.06, center[3] * 0.86}
    local rotation = {90, (colorIndex + 1) * 45, 90}
    local marker = spawnObject({
        type = "3DText",
        position = position,
        rotation = rotation,
        scale = {x=1.25, y=1.25, z=1.25},
    })
    marker.TextTool.setFontColor(fontColor)
    marker.TextTool.setFontSize(58)
    marker.TextTool.setValue(label)
    marker.setName("PokerRoleMarker")
    marker.setLock(true)
end

function refreshRoleMarkers()
    for _, obj in pairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.getName() == "PokerRoleMarker" then
            destroyObject(obj)
        end
    end

    local active = getActiveSeatIndexes()
    if #active < 2 then
        return
    end
    if dealerSeatIndex == 0 or colorStatusArray[dealerSeatIndex] ~= 1 then
        dealerSeatIndex = nextActiveSeat(0)
    end

    local smallBlindSeat = 0
    local bigBlindSeat = 0
    if #active == 2 then
        smallBlindSeat = dealerSeatIndex
        bigBlindSeat = nextActiveSeat(dealerSeatIndex)
    else
        smallBlindSeat = nextActiveSeat(dealerSeatIndex)
        bigBlindSeat = nextActiveSeat(smallBlindSeat)
    end

    if #active == 2 then
        spawnRoleMarker(dealerSeatIndex, "庄家 / 小盲", {r=1, g=0.82, b=0.25})
    else
        spawnRoleMarker(dealerSeatIndex, "庄家", {r=1, g=0.82, b=0.25})
        spawnRoleMarker(smallBlindSeat, "小盲", {r=0.35, g=0.85, b=1})
    end
    spawnRoleMarker(bigBlindSeat, "大盲", {r=1, g=0.4, b=0.4})
end

function initializeRoleMarkers()
    if dealerSeatIndex == 0 or colorStatusArray[dealerSeatIndex] ~= 1 then
        dealerSeatIndex = nextActiveSeat(0)
    end
    refreshRoleMarkers()
end

function advanceDealerAndRoles()
    dealerSeatIndex = nextActiveSeat(dealerSeatIndex)
    refreshRoleMarkers()
end

--[[ The onLoad event is called after the game save finishes loading. --]]
function onLoad()

    -- get Objects
    deckOfCards = getObjectFromGUID(deckOfCardsGUID)
    playButton = getObjectFromGUID(playButtonGUID)
    resetButton = getObjectFromGUID(resetButtonGUID)
    gatherButton = getObjectFromGUID(gatherButtonGUID)
    chipsButton = getObjectFromGUID(chipsButtonGUID)

    -- Set up Deck
    deckOfCards.setPosition(deckPosition)
    deckOfCards.setRotation(deckRotation)
    deckOfCards.shuffle()
    deckOfCards.setLock(true)
    deckX = deckOfCards.getPosition().x
    deckY = deckOfCards.getPosition().y
    deckZ = deckOfCards.getPosition().z

    -- Set button positions relative to Deck
    playButton.setPosition({deckX - 2.5, deckY-0.4, deckZ + 2.3})
    resetButton.setPosition({deckX + 4.5, deckY-0.4, deckZ + 2.3})
    gatherButton.setPosition({deckX + 1, deckY-0.4, deckZ + 2.3})
    chipsButton.setPosition({deckX + 1.2, deckY+0.2, deckZ - 14.4})

    -- Set other relative placement positions
    playAnchor = {deckX - 3, deckY-0.3, deckZ + 5}
    burnAnchor = {deckX - 2, deckY-0.4, deckZ }
    foldAnchor = {deckX + 2, deckY-0.4, deckZ }
    chipAnchor = {deckX - 2, deckY, deckZ - 2.5}
    -- Amount to offset color chip locations from local center
    localChipOffset = {-3, 0, -0.5}

    -- Destroy existing 3Dtext in case we reload / rewind.
    local objList = getAllObjects()
    for k,v in pairs(objList) do
        if v.getName() == "3DText" or v.getName() == "BettingAreaBorder" or v.getName() == "PokerRoleMarker" then
            destroyObject(v)
        end
    end

    createBettingAreaBorder()

    -- Update  status for any players already seated
    managePlayerStatus()
    initializeRoleMarkers()

    -- Timer that controls the automatic chip counters
    Timer.create({
        identifier     = "chipCountTimer",
        function_name  = "updateChipCounters",
        delay          = 0.5,
        repetitions    = 0,
    })

    print('Texas Holdem Poker - Scripted - loaded successfully!')

end

--*************************************************************************************************************************************************
--[[Button Functions]]
--*************************************************************************************************************************************************

--[[ Function to progress through the game based on the gameStateIndex.]]
--[[ Using wait functions to smoothly play cards]]
-- [[ GAME STATES]]
-- 0: Fresh game, no cards have been dealt
-- 1: Cards have been dealt to players, not to table
-- 2: Flop: 3 cards on table
-- 3: Turn: 4 cards on table
-- 4: River: 5 cards on table

function playGame(objectButtonClicked, playerColorClicked)
    local player = Player[playerColorClicked]
    -- [[ Progress the game based on the current state]]
    -- [[Disable button for a few seconds after each click to prevent doubleClicks]]
    if gameStateIndex == 0 then
        printToAll(player.steam_name .. " deals two cards to all seated players.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
        gameStateIndex = gameStateIndex + 1
        disableInputForDuration(5)
        dealCardsToPlayers()
        --[[ Update the Play button label]]
        objectButtonClicked.editButton({index=0, label='发翻牌', tooltip = '烧一张牌，然后在桌面翻开三张公共牌'})

    elseif gameStateIndex == 1 then
        printToAll(player.steam_name .. " deals the Flop.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
        gameStateIndex = gameStateIndex + 1
        disableInputForDuration(3.5)
        --[[ Play the Flop - burn 1, turn cards 1-3]]
        burnCard(1)
        Wait.time(function() playCard(1) end, 0.75 )
        Wait.time(function() playCard(2) end, 1.5 )
        Wait.time(function() playCard(3) end, 2.25 )
        --[[ Update the Play button label]]
        objectButtonClicked.editButton({index=0, label='发转牌', tooltip = '烧一张牌，然后翻开第四张公共牌'})

    elseif gameStateIndex == 2 then
        printToAll(player.steam_name .. " deals the Turn.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
        gameStateIndex = gameStateIndex + 1
        disableInputForDuration(2)
        --[[ Play the Turn - burn 1, turn card 4]]
        burnCard(2)
        Wait.time(function() playCard(4) end, 0.75 )
        --[[ Update the Play button label]]
        objectButtonClicked.editButton({index=0, label='发河牌', tooltip = '烧一张牌，然后翻开最后一张公共牌'})

    elseif gameStateIndex == 3 then
        printToAll(player.steam_name .. " deals the River.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
        gameStateIndex = gameStateIndex + 1
        disableInputForDuration(2)
        --[[ Play the River - burn 1, turn card 5]]
        burnCard(3)
        Wait.time(function() playCard(5) end, 0.75 )
        --[[ Disable the Play button]]
        objectButtonClicked.editButton({index=0, label=' ', tooltip = '下一局开始前按钮不可用', color = {100/255, 100/255, 100/255}, click_function ="emptyFunction"})

    end
end


--[[ Called when a user clicks on the Reset button --]]
--[[ Collect all cards back into the deck and shuffle. --]]
function resetGame(objectButtonClicked, playerColorClicked)
    local player = Player[playerColorClicked]
    printToAll(player.steam_name .. " has reset the game.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
    --[[ Reset the deck of cards and shuffle it --]]
        --[[ Disable input for a while --]]
    disableInputForDuration(1)

    -- [[First, reset the deck to get all cards we can out of player hands]]
    deckOfCards.reset()

    -- [[If cards were stacked they will lose their GUID and not reset properly. This script will search the zone to get all other cards and group them back to the main deck.]]
    local deckPosition = deckOfCards.getPosition()
    local objList = {getObjectFromGUID(deckOfCardsGUID)}
    local tableObjects = getObjectFromGUID(tableZoneGUID).getObjects()
    local cardIndex = 2
    --[[ Get all card or deck objects in the card zone. Start with the main deck, next index will be 2.]]
    for k,v in pairs(tableObjects) do
        if (v.tag == 'Deck' or v.tag == 'Card') and v.getGUID() ~= deckOfCardsGUID then
            objList[cardIndex] = getObjectFromGUID(v.getGUID())
            cardIndex = cardIndex+1
        end
    end

    --[[Group the straggler cards]]
    group(objList)

    -- [[Set position and shuffle, reset the play button]]
    deckOfCards.setPositionSmooth(deckPosition)
    deckOfCards.setRotationSmooth(deckRotation)
    deckOfCards.shuffle()
    deckOfCards.setLock(true)
    foldIndex = 0
    gameStateIndex = 0
    getObjectFromGUID(playButtonGUID).editButton({index=0, label='发牌', tooltip = '为所有已入座玩家发两张底牌', color = {111/255, 255/255, 125/255}, click_function ="playGame"})
    advanceDealerAndRoles()

end


--[[ Called when a player presses the Fold button. Only allow for playing colors.--]]
function handlePlayerFold(player, value, id)
    if player.color ~= "Grey" and player.color ~= "Black" then
    	printToAll(player.steam_name .. " folds!", colorNameToRGB(player.color))

    	--[[ Process each card in the user's hand --]]
    	local objectsInHand = player.getHandObjects()
    	for k, v in pairs(objectsInHand) do
    		--[[ Ensure the card is face-down--]]
    		if v.is_face_down == false then
    			v.flip()
    		end

            --[[Determine fold position]]
            local pos = {foldAnchor[1] + foldIndex/4, foldAnchor[2] + foldIndex/30, foldAnchor[3]}
            foldIndex = foldIndex + 1

            --[[ Wait timers here are very finnicky. Needed to get the timing exactly right to move and lock the cards appropriately]]
            --[[ Remove cards from hand, move cards to fold location and lock them.]]
            Wait.time(function() dropObj(v) end,0.7)
            Wait.time(function() v.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}) end,0.8)
            Wait.time(function() v.setPositionSmooth(pos) end,0.8)
            Wait.time(function() v.setLock(true) end, 0.9)
    	end
    end
end


--[[ Called when a player presses the Sort Chips button. Only allow for playing colors.--]]
-- Calls the sortChips function, passing in the player's chip zone.
function sortPlayerChips(player, value, id)

    if player.color ~= "Grey" and player.color ~= "Black" then
        local colorIndex = nil
        local colorZoneGUID = {nil}
        local chipOffsetVector = {nil}
        local chipPositions = {nil}

        -- [[Loop through the color name array to find our index]]
        for k, v in pairs (colorNameArray) do
            if v == player.color then
                colorIndex = k
            end
        end

        -- [[Now get our zone GUID and center position]]
        colorZoneGUID[1] = colorZoneArray[colorIndex]
        chipPositionVector = colorCenterArray[colorIndex]
        -- Revolution vector determines how we rotate the object positions relative to the player position. It is a factor of 45 based on the index-1
        chipRevolutionVector = {0, (colorIndex-1)*45, 0}
        -- Rotation vector determines the rotation of the actual chip faces. Default value is 90, so calculate it as 45*(index+1)
        chipRotation = {0, (colorIndex+1)*45, 0}

        -- Need to calculate the global chip locations based on our local vector. X value for Offset will adjust for each chip.
        for i=1,4,1 do
            chipOffsetVector[i] = {localChipOffset[1] + ((i-1)*chipSpacingX), localChipOffset[2], localChipOffset[3]}
            chipPositions[i] = LocalPos(chipPositionVector, chipRevolutionVector, chipOffsetVector[i])
        end

        -- [[ Now pass the seach zone, chip position array and rotation vector to the sort function]]
        sortChips(colorZoneGUID, chipPositions, chipRotation)
    end
end

-- [[ Called when a player presses the Gather Chips button on the table. Calls the sortChips function with the play area zones.]]
function sortTableChips(objectButtonClicked, playerColorClicked)
    local chipPositions = {nil}
    local player = Player[playerColorClicked]
    printToAll(player.steam_name .. " gathers the chips on the table.", colorNameToRGB(player.color))

    -- Need to calculate the location for each chip type based on the anchor and offset.
    for i=1,4,1 do
        chipPositions[i] = {chipAnchor[1] + ((i-1)*chipSpacingX), chipAnchor[2], chipAnchor[3]}
    end

    -- [[ Pass in all play zones. Chip anchor is already calculated, no rotation or offset vectors needed. Object rotation default is y=90. Pass in false to indicate this is the table gather.]]
    sortChips(playZoneGUIDs, chipPositions, chipBaseRotation)
end


-- [[Called from the spawn chips button on the table. Only allow from Black. Spawn 5k chips onto the table above the flop area.]]
function callSpawnChips(objectButtonClicked, playerColorClicked)
    local vPosition = {deckX + 1, deckY, deckZ + 7.5}
    if playerColorClicked == "Black" then
        spawnChips(vPosition)
    else
        printToColor("Only the Black color can spawn more chips.", playerColorClicked, {r=255,g=255,b=255})
    end
end


---------------------------------------------------------
--[[Play  Functions]]
-- These functions are called from button functions and handle the progression of the game.
---------------------------------------------------------

--[[ Deals 2 cards to all seated players --]]
function dealCardsToPlayers()
    -- Loop through the active players and deal two cards
    for i=1,2,1 do
        for colorIndex, playerStatus in pairs(colorStatusArray) do
            if playerStatus == 1 then
                deckOfCards.deal(1, colorNameArray[colorIndex])
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Plays a card to the table. Expects cardIndex of 1-5; 1-3= flop, 4 = turn, 5 = river
function playCard(cardIndex)
    cardsArray[cardIndex] = deckOfCards.takeObject()
    local cardPosition = {playAnchor[1] + ((cardIndex-1)*cardPlacementMult), playAnchor[2], playAnchor[3]}
    cardsArray[cardIndex].setPositionSmooth(cardPosition, false)
    Wait.time(function() cardsArray[cardIndex].flip() end, 0.7)
    Wait.time(function() cardsArray[cardIndex].setLock(true) end, 1.3)
end

-- Burns a card to the table
function burnCard(cardIndex)
    card = deckOfCards.takeObject()
    local cardPosition = {burnAnchor[1] - cardIndex/4, burnAnchor[2] + cardIndex/30, burnAnchor[3] }
    card.setLock(true)
    card.setPositionSmooth(cardPosition, false)
end

-- **************************************************************************************************************
-- [[ Chip Functions]]
-- These functions help manage chips on the board.
-- **************************************************************************************************************

-- Build the chip list used by counters and sorting. For the enlarged
-- central area, exclude chips that are simultaneously inside a player's
-- personal chip zone so they are not counted in or gathered into the pot.
function getFilteredChipTable(zoneGUIDs)
    local chipTable = buildObjTable(zoneGUIDs, {"Chip"})
    if zoneGUIDs ~= playZoneGUIDs then
        return chipTable
    end

    local playerChipTable = buildObjTable(colorZoneArray, {"Chip"})
    local playerChipGUIDs = {}
    for _, obj in pairs(playerChipTable) do
        playerChipGUIDs[obj.getGUID()] = true
    end

    local filtered = {}
    for _, obj in pairs(chipTable) do
        if not playerChipGUIDs[obj.getGUID()] then
            table.insert(filtered, obj)
        end
    end
    return filtered
end

-- This function groups the chips in a passed in zone and returns the count of chips it grouped
function groupChips(zoneGUIDs)
    local chipTable = getFilteredChipTable(zoneGUIDs)
    group(chipTable)
    return #chipTable
end


-- [[This function is called by both individual player sorts and full table sorts. It requires an array of zone GUIDs to check, and a relocation position reference.
function sortChips(zoneGUIDs, chipPositions, chipRotation)
    -- Group the chips in the passed zone.
    local chipCount = groupChips(zoneGUIDs)

    -- Brief delay for the chips to finish grouping
    moveDelay = 1 + chipCount*0.015

    -- Build the chip table again now that everything is grouped., then move the chips to their vector positions
    Wait.time(function() chipTable = getFilteredChipTable(zoneGUIDs) end, moveDelay)
    Wait.time(function() moveChips(chipTable, chipPositions, chipRotation) end, moveDelay)
end

-- [[ Takes in an object table, position vector, and rotation vector. Move chip stacks by their value to the specified location.]]
-- function moveChips(objTable, chipValue, vPosition, vRotation)
function moveChips(objTable, vPositionTable, vRotation)
    local chipValues = {50, 100, 500, 1000}
    for chipIndex, chipValue in pairs(chipValues) do
        for objIndex, obj in pairs(objTable) do
            if obj ~= nil then
                if obj.getValue() == chipValue then
                    Wait.time(function() obj.setPositionSmooth(vPositionTable[chipIndex], false) end, chipIndex/4)
                    Wait.time(function() obj.setRotationSmooth(vRotation, false) end, chipIndex/4)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end


function spawnChips(vPosition)
    local yIncrease = 0
    -- Spawns 5000 chips at the passed position vector.
    -- 5000 Chips made up of 4x50, 8x100, 6x600, 1x1000
    -- 50 x 4.
    chipParam = {
        type = "chip_50",
        position          = vPosition,
        rotation          = {0, 0, 0},
        scale             = {x=0.75, y=0.75, z=0.75},
    }
    -- Loop to spawn each chip then update the parameter.
    for i=1,4,1 do
        chipParam.position = {vPosition[1], vPosition[2] + yIncrease, vPosition[3]}
        yIncrease = yIncrease + 0.2
        spawnObject(chipParam)
    end
    -- 100 x 8
    chipParam.type = "chip_100"
    for i=1,8,1 do
        chipParam.position = {vPosition[1], vPosition[2] + yIncrease, vPosition[3]}
        yIncrease = yIncrease + 0.2
        spawnObject(chipParam)
    end
    -- 500 x 6
    chipParam.type = "chip_500"
    for i=1,6,1 do
        chipParam.position = {vPosition[1], vPosition[2] + yIncrease, vPosition[3]}
        yIncrease = yIncrease + 0.2
        spawnObject(chipParam)
    end
    -- 10000
    chipParam.type = "chip_1000"
    chipParam.position = {vPosition[1], vPosition[2] + yIncrease, vPosition[3]}
    yIncrease = yIncrease + 0.2
    spawnObject(chipParam)

end


-- [[This function counts the chips in each zone and passes the value to the corresponding text field. It will run on a delay timer]]
function updateChipCounters()
    -- First, count the chips in the play area.
    local colorZoneValue = 0
    local playZoneValue = countChips(playZoneGUIDs)
    UI.setValue("potValue", valueFormat(playZoneValue))

    -- Next, count the chips of seated players with counter objects.
    for colorIndex,obj in pairs(colorTextArray) do
        if obj ~= 0 then
            --[[ Update the text as the value of this player's chip count. Also reference the players status - if they are sitting out, add that to the text]]
            colorZoneValue = countChips({colorZoneArray[colorIndex]})
            local counterText = ""
            if colorStatusArray[colorIndex] == -1 then
                counterText = "暂离中\r\n"
            end
            obj.TextTool.setValue(counterText .. valueFormat(colorZoneValue))
        end
    end
end

--[[ Takes in a table of zone GUIDs and returns the total value of chips in those zones]]
function countChips(zoneGUIDs)
    --[[ Get a table of the unique objects in those zones]]
    local chipList = getFilteredChipTable(zoneGUIDs)
    local value = 0
    -- [[ Loop through the list and get the values]]
    for _,v in pairs(chipList) do
        --[[ For some reason a quantity of 1 is returning negative. Just take the absolute value.]]
        value = value + (v.getValue() * math.abs(v.getQuantity()))
    end
    return value
end

-- [[This function creats the chip counter for each player zone when that color joins.]]
function createPlayerChipCounter(color)
    local colorIndex = 0
    -- [[Loop through the color name array to find our index]]
    for k, v in pairs(colorNameArray) do
        if v == color then
            colorIndex = k
        end
    end

    -- [[ If we are a spectator or GM, ignore. Only create if we have not already created this object.]]
    if colorIndex ~= 0 and colorTextArray[colorIndex] == 0 then

        -- [[Now get our zone GUID and center position]]
        local zoneGUID = colorZoneArray[colorIndex]
        local vPosition = colorCenterArray[colorIndex]
        -- Revolution vector determines how we rotate the object positions relative to the player position. It is a factor of 45 based on the index-1
        local vRevolution = {0, (colorIndex-1)*45, 0}
        -- Rotation vector determines the rotation of the actual chip faces. Default value is 90, so calculate it as 45*(index+1)
        local vRotation = {90, (colorIndex+1)*45, 90}

        local vTextPosition = LocalPos(vPosition, vRevolution, {0, -2, 3.75})
        -- Need to calculate the global chip locations based on our local vector. X value for Offset will adjust for each chip.

        local textName = color.."ChipCounter"
        param =
        {
            type = "3DText",
            index             = colorIndex,
            position          = vTextPosition,
            rotation          = vRotation,
            scale             = {x=2, y=2, z=2},
        }
        obj = spawnObject(param)

        obj.TextTool.setFontColor(color)
        obj.TextTool.setFontSize(80)
        obj.TextTool.setValue(" ")
        obj.setName(textName)
        obj.setLock(true)

        colorTextArray[colorIndex] = obj

    end

end

-- Triggers a player's status as playing or sitting out. Only allow for playing colors.
function sitOut(player)
    if player.color ~= "Grey" and player.color ~= "Black" then
        local colorIndex = 0
        -- Get the color index
        for k, v in pairs(colorNameArray) do
            if v == player.color then
                colorIndex = k
            end
        end

        local currentStatus = colorStatusArray[colorIndex]
        -- Toggle button status. Dont have an else statement as we dont want to do anything for a 0.
        if currentStatus == 1 then
            printToAll(player.steam_name .. " is sitting out", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
            -- Sit Out and change button parameters
            colorStatusArray[colorIndex] = -1
            UI.setValue("sitOutButton", "返回游戏")
        elseif currentStatus == -1 then
            printToAll(player.steam_name .. " has rejoined the game", colorNameToRGB(player.color))
            -- Rejoin and change button parameters
            colorStatusArray[colorIndex] = 1
            UI.setValue("sitOutButton", "暂离")
        end
    end
end


-- Creates and destroys chip counters based on seated players. Spawns chips for new players.
function managePlayerStatus()

    local seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()
    local playerFound = false
    local chipCount = 0
    -- loop through the color array, and grab the text object.
    for colorIndex, colorName in pairs(colorNameArray) do
        textObj = colorTextArray[colorIndex]

        -- Now loop through the seated players to find a match.
        playerFound = false
        for playerIndex, playerColor in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
            if colorName == playerColor then
                -- Found a match. If the text object doesnt exist, create it.
                playerFound = true
                if textObj == 0 then
                    createPlayerChipCounter(playerColor)
                end

                -- If this is the first time the player has joined and they have no chips, spawn them.
                chipCount = countChips({colorZoneArray[colorIndex]})
                if colorStatusArray[colorIndex] == -2 and chipCount == 0 then
                    printToAll(playerColor .. " has joined the game and receives 10,000 chips.", colorNameToRGB(playerColor))
                    -- Spawn 10k chips and trigger the colors sort.
                    for i = 1,2,1 do
                        spawnChips(colorCenterArray[colorIndex])
                    end
                    Wait.time(function() sortPlayerChips(Player[playerColor]) end, 1)
                elseif (colorStatusArray[colorIndex] ~= -1 and colorStatusArray[colorIndex] ~= 1) then
                    printToAll(playerColor .. " has re-joined the game.", colorNameToRGB(playerColor))
                end

                -- Player found, now set status = 1
                colorStatusArray[colorIndex] = 1
            end
        end
        -- After looping, if we havent found the player, set the status to 0 and delete the Chipcounter if it exists.
        if playerFound == false and colorStatusArray[colorIndex] ~= -2 then
            colorStatusArray[colorIndex] = 0
            if textObj ~= 0 then
                colorTextArray[colorIndex] = 0
                destroyObject(textObj)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- These functions are called from other functions to handle repeated tasks.

--[[ Function that takes in a table of zone GUIDs and table of object types, then creates a table array of all objects of the passed types within those zones. ]]
function buildObjTable(zoneGUIDs, objTypes)

    local objTable = {}
    local hash = {}
    local prunedTable = {}
    -- Three stages of loops. First loop is through each passed zone. Second is for the objects in that zone. Third is through the object types table to compare the accepted types to the found object.
    for zoneIndex, zoneGUID in pairs(zoneGUIDs) do
        -- If objects get deleted (like from flipping the table) don't run this.
        if getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID) ~= nil then
            zoneObjects = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID).getObjects()
            -- Now loop through the zone objects to find chips and add them to our list
            for objIndex, obj in pairs(zoneObjects) do
                -- Now loop through the objectTypes to match to. Gtab the GUID so we can prune unique values and return their objects.
                for typeIndex, type in pairs(objTypes) do
                    if obj.tag == type then
                        objTable[#objTable+1] = obj.getGUID()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- If we have overlapping zones, there is a chance our list will have duplicate objects. Prune the list to make it unique, and return the objects.
    for _,v in ipairs(objTable) do
       if (not hash[v]) then
           prunedTable[#prunedTable+1] = getObjectFromGUID(v)
           hash[v] = true
       end
    end

    return prunedTable
end

-- [[Format a number with commas and dollar signs]]
function valueFormat(amount)
    local formatted = amount
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if (k==0) then
            break
        end
    end
    return "$"..formatted
end



-- [[Script to determine local position vector]]
--[[ Input parameters are global position of the reference object, the rotation reference to pivot from, and the positional offset ]]
function LocalPos(sourcePosition, sourceRotation, offsetVector)
    local lPos = {offsetVector[1], offsetVector[2], offsetVector[3]}

    -- Z-X-Y extrinsic
    local xRot = RotMatrix('x', sourceRotation[1])
    lPos = RotateVector(xRot, lPos)
    local yRot = RotMatrix('y', sourceRotation[2])
    lPos = RotateVector(yRot, lPos)
    local zRot = RotMatrix('z', sourceRotation[3])
    lPos = RotateVector(zRot, lPos)

    return Vect_Sum(lPos, sourcePosition)
end

-- Build rotation matrix
-- 1st table = 1st row, 2nd table = 2nd row etc
function RotMatrix(axis, angDeg)
    local ang = math.rad(angDeg)
    local cs = math.cos
    local sn = math.sin

    if axis == 'x' then
        return {
                    { 1,        0,             0 },
                    { 0,   cs(ang),   -1*sn(ang) },
                    { 0,   sn(ang),      cs(ang) }
               }
    elseif axis == 'y' then
        return {
                    {    cs(ang),   0,   sn(ang) },
                    {          0,   1,         0 },
                    { -1*sn(ang),   0,   cs(ang) }
               }
    elseif axis == 'z' then
        return {
                    { cs(ang),   -1*sn(ang),   0 },
                    { sn(ang),      cs(ang),   0 },
                    { 0,                  0,   1 }
               }
    end
end

-- Apply given rotation matrix on given vector
-- (multiply matrix and column vector)
function RotateVector(rotMat, vect)
    local out = {0, 0, 0}
    for i=1,3,1 do
        for j=1,3,1 do
            out[i] = out[i] + rotMat[i][j]*vect[j]
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- Sum of two vectors (of any size)
function Vect_Sum(vec1, vec2)
    local out = {}
    local k = 1
    while vec1[k] ~= nil and vec2[k] ~= nil do
        out[k] = vec1[k] + vec2[k]
        k = k+1
    end
    return out
end
